children: Live Nation announced two financing actions to strengthen liquidity and refinance near-term debt. The company completed a private offering of $730.0 million and €600.0 million senior notes due 2032, with proceeds earmarked to redeem its 6.500% Senior Secured Notes due 2027 and for general purposes. Cross-currency swaps on the dollar notes reduce the weighted average interest rate on the new notes to about 5.89% through Oct. 15, 2031. Separately, Live Nation amended its senior secured credit facilities, extending revolver and delayed draw term loan maturities to Oct. 21, 2031 and increasing total commitments to approximately $2.61 billion, enhancing financial flexibility.
Agreement 1: Live Nation Raises $730 Million and €600 Million in 2032 Senior Notes to Refinance Debt
: Senior notes indenture and private offering (2032 maturity)
: U.S. Bank Trust Company and U.S. Bank Europe
: Refinance 2027 secured notes and reduce interest cost
Agreement 2: Live Nation Amends Credit Facilities, Extends Revolvers to 2031 and Lifts Commitments to $2.61 Billion
: JPMorgan Chase Bank and other lenders
: Extend maturities and expand liquidity for operations and growth
